name: CaseChildOrderReversedByAxis
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "child-order-reversed-by-axis" (layout). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: CHILD ORDER that varies on one enum axis — the container's flex-direction keyword is `row` for BOTH values and the DOM order of the two children is reversed instead (the fluent.switch / fluent.spinner labelPosition shape)
